note: Palestine's national spirits. The ones with `start` describe the situation on 1 January 2000 and cite sources. Values are gameplay estimates.

spirits.name: Limited self-rule
spirits.description: Under the Oslo Accords the Palestinian Authority has partial civil control in parts of the West Bank and Gaza.

spirits.name: Under occupation
spirits.description: The West Bank and the Gaza Strip are under Israeli occupation.

spirits.name: Divided territories
spirits.description: The West Bank and Gaza are ruled by rival governments.

spirits.name: National unity
spirits.description: Fatah and Hamas share one government.

spirits.name: International recognition
spirits.description: A growing number of states recognise the State of Palestine.

spirits.name: Donor support
spirits.description: Aid from donors pays salaries and builds infrastructure.
